title: Rewinding after halting
statement: Let $K$ and $W$ be finite Turing machines over the binary alphabet, let $x$ be a binary input, and let $c$ be a configuration of $K$ on $x$ whose state is absent. Starting the clock machine from the lifted configuration of $c$ and running it for $|c.\mathrm{output}|+2$ steps yields a configuration in state $\mathrm{iStart}$, with input head at the position in $c$, the work tapes of $K$ unchanged, the counter tape storing $c.\mathrm{output}$ with its head at cell $0$, all work tapes belonging to $W$ blank with their heads at cell $0$, and empty output.
